An edit made now would be a guess with no evidence behind it, since neither ending has been judged and the runs themselves weren't in front of me. The two judge figures need a rerun once the Fable quota for the eval kit's judge is available again, and that rerun will show whether either ending has a real problem; nothing was run or re-measured here.
